anchors.label: Open
anchors.description: Open a BAM, BigBed, BigWig, GTF, FASTA or a saved session file; the arrow beside it lists the Library, Load by path / URL, Connect to cluster, Process raw data (New DAF-seq run) and Data quality.

anchors.label: Save
anchors.description: Download a session file you can reload later with Open.

anchors.label: Export
anchors.description: Export a figure of what you see (PNG, SVG or PDF). Data exports are under Data (Export data).

anchors.label: Settings rail
anchors.description: Each icon opens one page of settings: Data & Sessions, Reference & Tracks, Reads & Display, Analysis & Reproducibility. Click another icon to switch, the same icon (or the X) to close; Cmd/Ctrl+B reopens the last page.

anchors.label: Tutorial > Start from the beginning
anchors.description: A scripted walk through the main tools on a demo dataset; the Tutorial panel also starts it at any step.

anchors.label: Layout > Equal widths
anchors.description: The Layout panel arranges all panels at once: Equal widths evens out their widths; Reset puts rows and sizes back.

anchors.label: Undo
anchors.description: Undo the last change (Cmd+Z).

anchors.label: More menu
anchors.description: Reset view, analysis details, keyboard shortcuts and quit.

anchors.label: Reset view
anchors.where: top bar, in the More menu at the right end
anchors.description: Clear clustering, filters and selections in one step (R); Undo brings them back.

anchors.label: Redo
anchors.description: Redo (Cmd+Shift+Z).

anchors.label: History timeline
anchors.description: Jump back to any earlier step of the session.

anchors.label: Search box
anchors.description: Type a gene name or coordinates (chr2R:9,970,000-9,980,000) and press Enter.

anchors.label: Chromosome selector
anchors.description: Pick a chromosome from the loaded reference.

anchors.label: Zoom in
anchors.description: Zoom in 1.5x (keyboard: up arrow or +).

anchors.label: Zoom out
anchors.description: Zoom out 1.5x (keyboard: down arrow or -). Reads are drawn only while the view is smaller than the read window.

anchors.label: Pan left
anchors.description: Shift the view left (keyboard: left arrow).

anchors.label: Pan right
anchors.description: Shift the view right (keyboard: right arrow).

anchors.label: Go to reads
anchors.description: Jump to the next best-covered window at this zoom, deepest first.

anchors.label: Spanning only
anchors.description: Only show reads that cover the whole view edge to edge; off shows every overlapping read.

anchors.label: Reverse view
anchors.description: Flip the view 3' to 5'; reads and coordinates reverse.

anchors.label: TSS-relative coordinates
anchors.description: Show coordinates relative to the selected gene's TSS.

anchors.label: Reads toolbar group
anchors.description: How reads are drawn: all reads or a sample, row height, spacing.

anchors.label: All / sample reads toggle
anchors.description: Switch between drawing every read and a random sample.

anchors.label: Read row height
anchors.description: Pixels per read row (Cmd/Ctrl+scroll over the reads also changes it).

anchors.label: Layer toggles
anchors.description: Show or hide each layer: nucleosomes, TF footprints, FIRE/MSP, m6A, 5mC, deamination.

anchors.label: Peaks toolbar group
anchors.description: Peak count, Scan, lock, draw and peak rules.

anchors.label: Scan
anchors.description: Detect peaks in the current view with the enabled peak rules.

anchors.label: Lock peaks
anchors.description: Freeze the current peaks so navigating doesn't rescan them.

anchors.label: Draw a peak
anchors.description: Draw your own peak: click a start and an end on the Peaks track.

anchors.label: Peak rules
anchors.description: Edit the rules that define peaks (source layer, threshold, width).

anchors.label: Clear peak selection
anchors.description: Deselect all peaks.

anchors.label: Peaks track
anchors.description: Detected peaks. Click one to select it; Cmd/Ctrl+click adds to the selection.

anchors.label: Cluster toolbar group
anchors.description: Clustering method, K and the Cluster button.

anchors.label: Cluster
anchors.description: Group reads by their footprints at the selected peaks.

anchors.label: Clustering method
anchors.description: K-means (exact or fast), hierarchical, HDBSCAN, combinatorial, or Neighbourhoods (groups on the t-SNE map, with a Resolution).

anchors.label: K
anchors.description: Number of clusters for K-means / KMeans++ (2-20).

anchors.label: Merge similar clusters
anchors.description: Merge tiny clusters and near-duplicates into their nearest cluster.

anchors.label: Cluster details
anchors.description: Open the Clusters panel.

anchors.label: Clear clusters
anchors.description: Remove the current clustering.

anchors.label: Cluster rules
anchors.description: Open the Rules panel on the Cluster tab.

anchors.label: Sort
anchors.description: Order reads (and clusters) by the chosen sort rule.

anchors.label: Sort rules
anchors.description: Open the Rules panel on the Sort tab.

anchors.label: Lock cluster order
anchors.description: Keep the cluster order fixed when re-sorting or zooming.

anchors.label: Filter
anchors.description: Hide reads that fail the chosen filter rule.

anchors.label: Filter rules
anchors.description: Open the Rules panel on the Filter tab.

anchors.label: Clear filter
anchors.description: Remove the active read filter so every read shows again.

anchors.label: Quality
anchors.description: Minimum call quality per layer; calls below it are hidden.

anchors.label: Quality cutoffs
anchors.description: Set the minimum call quality for each layer.

anchors.label: Reads controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Reads group
anchors.description: Click the small Reads label to show or hide the rest of the Reads controls.

anchors.label: Layers controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Layers group
anchors.description: Click the small Layers label to show or hide the rest of the Layers controls.

anchors.label: Peaks controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Peaks group
anchors.description: Click the small Peaks label to show or hide the rest of the Peaks controls.

anchors.label: Cluster controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Cluster group
anchors.description: Click the small Cluster label to show or hide the rest of the Cluster controls.

anchors.label: Sort controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Sort group
anchors.description: Click the small Sort label to show or hide the rest of the Sort controls.

anchors.label: Filter controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Filter group
anchors.description: Click the small Filter label to show or hide the rest of the Filter controls.

anchors.label: Quality controls toggle
anchors.where: toolbar, start of the Quality group
anchors.description: Click the small Quality label to show or hide the rest of the Quality controls.

anchors.label: Analysis panels
anchors.where: the coloured tiles in the rail at the right edge (or, with Analysis panels set to Strip (classic), the strip below the toolbar)
anchors.description: One coloured tile per analysis panel (Clusters, Footprints, Rules, ...); hover for its name, click to open it.

anchors.label: Reads
anchors.description: One row per molecule. Click a footprint to inspect it; Shift+click selects the read; Cmd/Ctrl+click analyses the footprint.

anchors.label: Panel actions (⋯)
anchors.where: dataset panel header, when it is too narrow for every action
anchors.description: The header's actions that don't fit beside the name.

anchors.label: + Add a copy
anchors.where: dataset panel header (or its ⋯ menu when narrow)
anchors.description: Add a copy of the panel; unlink it to view another locus, chromosome or haplotype.

anchors.label: Compare haplotypes…
anchors.where: dataset panel header (or its ⋯ menu when narrow)
anchors.description: Opens Regions › Compare haplotypes with this panel's chromosome and coordinates filled in.

anchors.label: Full view
anchors.description: Expand one panel to fill the window; click again to restore.

anchors.label: Tracks in this panel
anchors.description: Every track of the panel: show, remove, restore, reorder, and add tracks (also from any track's right-click menu).

anchors.label: Minimize panel
anchors.description: Minimize the panel to a chip at the bottom.

anchors.label: Close panel
anchors.description: Close the panel (removes the dataset if it is its last panel).

anchors.label: Minimized panel chip
anchors.where: bottom of the tracks, or sidebar > Loaded Datasets
anchors.description: Click a minimized panel's chip to restore it.

anchors.label: Row bar
anchors.description: Click to collapse or expand a whole row of panels.
anchors.shows_when: panels are arranged in more than one row

anchors.label: Panel location bar
anchors.description: The copy's own location box, pan and zoom.

anchors.label: Link / Unlink
anchors.description: Link the copy to the main view, or unlink it to move it on its own.

anchors.label: Strand chip
anchors.description: Choose CT, GA or both strands, or split the panel into a CT and a GA panel.

anchors.label: Split into CT and GA panels
anchors.description: Show CT reads in this panel and GA reads in a copy beside it; both follow the main view.

anchors.label: Data & Sessions
anchors.description: Load data, manage loaded datasets, and save or restore sessions.

anchors.label: Reference & Tracks
anchors.description: Reference FASTA and gene annotation, bundled genomes and online tracks.

anchors.label: Reads & Display
anchors.description: Read rendering, navigation, display limits and read filters.

anchors.label: Analysis & Reproducibility
anchors.description: Sampling seed, peak detection and analysis settings.

anchors.label: Restore session
anchors.description: Reload a saved session file.

anchors.label: Load by path
anchors.description: Type a local or server path to load a file.

anchors.label: Load Remote URL
anchors.description: Load a file from an https:// or s3:// URL.

anchors.label: Loaded Datasets
anchors.description: Every loaded dataset: rename, recolour, merge, restore minimized panels.

anchors.label: Session
anchors.description: Save, export or copy a link to the session.

anchors.label: Reference Files
anchors.description: Load the reference FASTA and gene annotation for your data.

anchors.label: Load Reference FASTA
anchors.description: Load or change the reference FASTA (needed for sequence, primers and motifs).

anchors.label: Load gene annotation
anchors.description: Load a GTF/GFF/BED gene annotation (needed for gene search and the gene track).

anchors.label: Load Plasmid Map
anchors.description: Add a plasmid map (GenBank, SnapGene, EMBL, SBOL) as its own contig.

anchors.label: Multiple FASTA / annotation pairs
anchors.description: Load several references at once, e.g. two haplotypes with distinct chromosome names.

anchors.label: Genome list
anchors.where: sidebar > Reference & Tracks > Online Genome & Tracks
anchors.description: Switch to a bundled genome (dm6, hg38, mm10, ...); its gene annotation loads with it.

anchors.label: Open Tracks...
anchors.where: sidebar > Reference & Tracks > Online Genome & Tracks
anchors.description: Open the Tracks panel to add UCSC, ENCODE or ChIP-Atlas tracks.

anchors.label: Read Display
anchors.description: Row height, separators, colours and display limits.

anchors.label: Show reads up to
anchors.description: Largest view in which individual reads are drawn; beyond it a coverage histogram is shown.

anchors.label: Navigation
anchors.description: Gene padding, autozoom and navigation options.

anchors.label: Read Filters
anchors.description: Minimum footprints, gap and quality filters on which reads are shown.

anchors.label: Reproducibility
anchors.description: Sample size and seed so clustering and profiles repeat exactly.

anchors.label: Peak Detection
anchors.description: Defaults for peak scanning.

anchors.label: Clusters > Overview tab
anchors.description: Every cluster with its read count; focus, hide, select, merge or subcluster clusters.

anchors.label: Hidden clusters / Unhide all
anchors.description: When a cluster focus hides reads, Unhide all shows every cluster again. Clicking a colour in the bar left of the reads also toggles the focus.

anchors.label: Clusters > Profiles tab
anchors.description: Each cluster's average profile, overlaid.

anchors.label: Clusters > Composition tab
anchors.description: Each cluster's mix of footprint types.

anchors.label: Clusters > V-Plot tab
anchors.description: Footprint size against position, per cluster.

anchors.label: Clusters > Projection tab
anchors.description: Each read as a dot on a t-SNE map (or UMAP, PCA), coloured by cluster; Export table saves it. Also the Merge similar clusters preview.

anchors.label: Merge similar clusters (Clusters panel)
anchors.description: Merge tiny clusters and near-duplicates into their nearest cluster.

anchors.label: Merge similar clusters settings
anchors.description: Smallest-cluster % and similarity cutoff for merging, with a before/after preview in the Projection tab.

anchors.label: Snapshot
anchors.description: Save the current clustering to come back to it (Saved tab).

anchors.label: Clusters > Saved tab
anchors.description: Saved clusterings; click one to restore it.

anchors.label: Cluster branch map
anchors.description: Subcluster branches; click a branch to switch to it.

anchors.label: Dynamic reassignment
anchors.description: Reassign reads to the nearest cluster as you pan.

anchors.label: Rules > Cluster tab
anchors.description: Reusable cluster rules: which footprints at which regions define clusters.

anchors.label: Rules > Sort tab
anchors.description: Reusable sort rules for the Sort button.

anchors.label: Rules > Filter tab
anchors.description: Reusable filter rules for the Filter button.

anchors.label: Rules > Peaks tab
anchors.description: Peak rules used by Scan.

anchors.label: Add cluster rule
anchors.description: Add a new cluster rule.

anchors.label: Add sort rule
anchors.description: Add a new sort rule.

anchors.label: Add filter rule
anchors.description: Add a new filter rule.

anchors.label: Labeling > Rules tab
anchors.description: Colour footprints by size, layer, region, motif or track overlap.

anchors.label: Add labeling rule
anchors.description: Add a colour rule.

anchors.label: Labeling > Quality tab
anchors.description: Quality cutoffs and shading per layer.

anchors.label: Peak Detection panel
anchors.description: Peak rules: source layer, threshold, minimum width.

anchors.label: Footprints > Classes tab
anchors.description: The Classes tab: the footprint you Cmd/Ctrl+clicked (its sizes, to save), then Find footprint classes and the class table.

anchors.label: Footprints > Saved tab
anchors.description: Saved footprint definitions you can label, filter and cluster by.

anchors.label: Footprints > Co-occupancy tab
anchors.description: Which saved footprints occur together on the same molecules; cluster reads by them.

anchors.label: Selected footprint
anchors.description: The footprint you Cmd/Ctrl+clicked: its size range and where it sits; Save keeps it as a definition.

anchors.label: Save (this footprint)
anchors.description: Save this size range at this position; it is coloured on reads and listed in the Saved tab.

anchors.label: Save all selected footprints
anchors.description: With two or more footprints selected: save each with its default size range.

anchors.label: Find footprint classes
anchors.description: Find the footprint classes that recur in this view across molecules (lattice recaller); a few kb take a minute or two.

anchors.label: Read Stats > Summary tab
anchors.description: Summary of the Shift+clicked reads.

anchors.label: Read Stats > Table tab
anchors.description: One row per selected read: span, footprints, accessibility, MAPQ.

anchors.label: Reads (group)
anchors.description: Which reads the statistics describe: the selected reads, every read shown, or one cluster.

anchors.label: Browse hubs
anchors.description: Browse UCSC, ENCODE and ChIP-Atlas tracks for the current genome.

anchors.label: Add metaprofile
anchors.description: Add a metaprofile track built from your reads.

anchors.label: Add a track file or URL
anchors.description: Add a BigWig, BigBed or BED track by path, URL or upload.

anchors.label: Co-accessibility matrix
anchors.description: How often pairs of positions are open on the same molecule.

anchors.label: Refresh co-accessibility
anchors.description: Recompute the matrix for the current view.

anchors.label: Save view
anchors.description: Save the current view as a region, named after its nearest gene, in a category of the Regions catalog.

anchors.label: Load plasmid map
anchors.description: Load a plasmid map and view it as a circular contig.

anchors.label: Primers > Design tab
anchors.description: Design primers around the selected peaks or the view.

anchors.label: Design primers
anchors.description: Run primer design (with BLAST specificity when configured).

anchors.label: Primers > Order list tab
anchors.description: Saved primers, exported as an order sheet (IDT, Twist, ...).

anchors.label: Add capture region
anchors.description: Add the view or selection as a capture region.

anchors.label: Capture > Export tab
anchors.description: Export capture regions as BED, FASTA or probes.

anchors.label: Contacts > Map tab
anchors.description: The contact map (Micro-C / DAF-C).

anchors.label: Regions > Compare haplotypes tab
anchors.description: Compare two haplotypes or two loci side by side in linked panels.

anchors.label: Haplotype comparison form
anchors.description: Pick the two haplotype chromosomes (or loci) and open them side by side.

anchors.label: Transcription > Filters tab
anchors.description: Filter reads by Pol II state (PIC, paused, elongating) at the selected genes.

anchors.label: Transcription > Distribution tab
anchors.description: Share of reads in each Pol II state.

anchors.label: Layout panel
anchors.description: Arrange, rename, link and merge dataset panels; save layout presets.

anchors.label: Link datasets
anchors.description: Link the selected panels so they move together.

anchors.label: Merge datasets
anchors.description: Merge the selected datasets into one panel.

anchors.label: Annotations > Files tab
anchors.description: Per-read annotation files and their types.

anchors.label: Annotations > Filter tab
anchors.description: Filter reads by annotation type.

anchors.label: Copilot box
anchors.description: Ask how to do something.

anchors.label: + Add Rule
anchors.description: Adds a peak rule: a signal source (accessibility, FIRE, a layer, m6A, a track, or Custom draw) scanned for peaks.

anchors.label: Peak rule
anchors.description: One rule per row: its checkbox enables it, its colour marks its peaks, and clicking the row opens its settings. The number is its peak count.

anchors.label: Peak rule Source
anchors.description: The signal this rule scans: accessibility, FIRE, a footprint layer, a modification, a loaded track, or Custom (draw).

anchors.label: Rule signal profile
anchors.description: The rule's signal across the view with its cutoffs drawn in; peaks are where it rises above them.

anchors.label: Signal cutoffs
anchors.description: Strong / Medium / Weak / Rare cutoffs (0–1); Fill from percentile sets them from this view once.

anchors.label: Presets ▾
anchors.description: Save and load sets of peak rules, import or export peaks as BED, and import/export the rules as JSON.

anchors.label: Import Peak BED...
anchors.description: Loads BED peaks as locked imported peaks on the current chromosome.

anchors.label: Circular / Linear
anchors.description: Switches the chromosome map between a circular and a linear view (for plasmids and small circular contigs).

anchors.label: Chromosome map
anchors.description: The whole chromosome; click anywhere to move the view there.

anchors.label: Zoom window
anchors.description: Sets how much of the chromosome around the view the zoom window map shows.

anchors.label: Zoom window map
anchors.description: The genes around the view, with the view marked; click a gene to go to it, or anywhere to move the view there.

anchors.label: Open side by side
anchors.description: With saved regions ticked: open them (up to eight) as panel copies, side by side.
anchors.shows_when: saved regions are ticked in the Regions tab

anchors.label: Saved regions
anchors.description: The saved regions of the current category: click a name to go there, tick several to highlight, open side by side or move them; each row's ⋯ has Edit coordinates, Open beside and Delete.

anchors.label: History steps
anchors.description: Every change, newest first; click one to restore its analysis state without moving the view.

anchors.label: View (history step)
anchors.description: Restores that step and also jumps to its viewport.

anchors.label: Clear history
anchors.description: Empties the undo history.

anchors.label: Gene track
anchors.where: each dataset panel, under the reads
anchors.description: Genes in view. Click a gene to select it, Shift+click to add more, Cmd/Ctrl+click to select it and open Transcription.

anchors.label: Pause / PIC / Elongating
anchors.description: Tick the Pol II states to keep; each shows how many reads at the selected genes are in it.

anchors.label: Minimum Pol II count
anchors.description: How many elongating Pol II footprints a read needs to count as elongating (plus an optional maximum).

anchors.label: State thresholds
anchors.description: Opens the elongating Pol II count thresholds.

anchors.label: Apply (Transcription)
anchors.description: Filters the reads to the ticked states.

anchors.label: Clear (Transcription)
anchors.description: Removes the transcription filter.

anchors.label: JSON (Transcription)
anchors.description: Exports the settings and state counts; TSV next to it exports one row per read.

anchors.label: Transcription > Co-occur tab
anchors.description: How often two states occur together on the same molecule.

anchors.label: Transcription > Pol II COM tab
anchors.description: Where along the gene each read's Pol II sits (centre of mass), by cluster.

anchors.label: Co-accessibility Settings
anchors.description: Opens the signal, normalization, coverage and track-display settings.

anchors.label: Signal
anchors.description: What is correlated between positions: accessibility, nucleosome, small footprint, linker or all footprints.

anchors.label: Normalization
anchors.description: Raw co-occurrence, O/E against each position's marginal or against distance, or correlation.

anchors.label: Min coverage
anchors.description: Cells with fewer reads than this are masked (grey).

anchors.label: Track Display
anchors.description: Draws the result under the reads as a Heatmap Strip, Arcs, or a Virtual 4C profile.

anchors.label: Layer chips
anchors.description: Which footprint layer the signal is read from.

anchors.label: Reads / bins / coverage
anchors.description: How many reads, the bin size, median coverage and how much of the matrix is masked.

anchors.label: JSON (Co-accessibility)
anchors.description: Exports the matrix and its settings; TSV and Python sit next to it.

anchors.label: Annotations > Types tab
anchors.description: Every annotation type in the files: toggle, recolour and set its overlay threshold.

anchors.label: Annotations > Cluster tab
anchors.description: Clusters reads by which annotation types they carry at the selected peaks.

anchors.label: Annotations > Profile tab
anchors.description: Density of each annotation type across the view.

anchors.label: Load File... (Annotations)
anchors.description: Loads a per-read annotation BigBed.

anchors.label: Annotation types
anchors.description: One row per type: checkbox shows it on the reads, the swatch sets its colour.

anchors.label: Has Any / Has All / Lacks All
anchors.description: Keep reads that carry any, all, or none of the ticked types.

anchors.label: Apply Filter (Annotations)
anchors.description: Filters the reads by the ticked annotation types.

anchors.label: Cluster (Annotations)
anchors.description: Clusters by the ticked types at the selected peaks (Combinatorial or K-means).

anchors.label: Capture > Regions tab
anchors.description: The capture cart: regions to target for enrichment, with their padded sizes.

anchors.label: Target preview
anchors.description: The region the selected peaks span, before padding.

anchors.label: Padding
anchors.description: Extra bp added on each side of every region.

anchors.label: + Bounding
anchors.description: Adds one region spanning the selected peaks.

anchors.label: Export format
anchors.description: BED, Twist TSV, FASTA or Probe TSV (FASTA and probes need a reference).

anchors.label: Download (Capture)
anchors.description: Downloads the regions in the chosen format.

anchors.label: Read Stats > Distributions tab
anchors.description: Histograms of accessibility, footprint size, read length, MAPQ and modification % for the selected reads.

anchors.label: TSV (Read Stats)
anchors.description: Downloads one row per selected read; Copy TSV and JSON sit next to it.

anchors.label: Select cluster reads
anchors.description: Selects every read of the focused cluster.

anchors.label: Deselect
anchors.description: Clears the read selection.

anchors.label: Locus X / Locus Y
anchors.description: Two genes or regions to show side by side as linked panels.

anchors.label: Create Split View
anchors.description: Opens Locus X and Locus Y as two linked panels.

anchors.label: Split Current View
anchors.description: Splits the current view into two halves.

anchors.label: Contacts > Settings tab
anchors.description: How contacts are drawn under the reads: matrix strip, arcs, or Virtual 4C.

anchors.label: Track overlay
anchors.description: Picks Matrix strip, Arcs or Virtual 4C and the maximum contact distance.

anchors.label: Matrix strip settings
anchors.description: Scale, colours and normalization (Raw, Balanced, O/E local or global).

anchors.label: Arcs settings
anchors.description: Minimum distance, normalization, strength and accessibility correction for arcs.

anchors.label: Virtual 4C settings
anchors.description: Normalization, smoothing and minimum count for the viewpoint profile.

anchors.label: Open Regions
anchors.description: Opens the two ends of a selected contact rectangle as linked panels of the reads that join them.
anchors.shows_when: a rectangle is selected on the contact map

anchors.label: Select panel (Layout)
anchors.description: Tick panels here, then Merge, Link, Unlink or Unmerge them.

anchors.label: Dataset label
anchors.description: Click to rename a dataset panel.

anchors.label: Unlink
anchors.description: Unlinks the selected panels so each moves on its own.

anchors.label: Unmerge
anchors.description: Splits a merged dataset back into its files.

anchors.label: Reset (Layout)
anchors.description: Resets rows, sizes and track layout.

anchors.label: Merge / Link Tree
anchors.description: How the panels are grouped: which are merged, which are linked, and which move on their own.

anchors.label: Save Arrangement
anchors.description: Saves the current datasets, groups and order under a name.

anchors.label: Saved Arrangements
anchors.description: Load a saved arrangement to reopen its datasets and groups.

anchors.label: Labeling rule
anchors.description: One rule per row, top rule wins: its size range, layers and conditions, and the colour it paints.

anchors.label: Edit rule ▸
anchors.description: Opens a rule's settings.

anchors.label: Size range
anchors.description: Footprints between these sizes (bp) get this rule's colour.

anchors.label: Rule colour
anchors.description: A solid colour or a gradient across the size range.

anchors.label: Layers (rule)
anchors.description: Which layers the rule applies to (all when none is ticked).

anchors.label: + Add condition
anchors.description: Restricts the rule to footprints in a gene, a peak, a track or a motif track (or NOT in one).

anchors.label: + Add quality gate
anchors.description: Only colours calls whose quality score passes (e.g. aq ≥ 230 for confident FIRE calls).

anchors.label: Display options
anchors.description: Background colours, opacity of unmatched layers, and edge ambiguity shading.

anchors.label: Clusters > Differences tab
anchors.description: What sets each cluster apart: per labeling rule, how much more or less common a matching footprint is in the cluster than in all other clusters, with intervals and Fisher tests.

anchors.label: V-plot settings
anchors.description: Size bins, layer and axes of the footprint size-vs-position plot.

anchors.label: Projection Method / View
anchors.description: t-SNE (default), UMAP or PCA of the reads, before or after Merge similar clusters, or side by side; Export table writes each read's map position.

anchors.label: Merge similar clusters (preview settings)
anchors.description: Smallest cluster % and similarity cutoff, with a preview of what would merge and Merge now.

anchors.label: Footprint classes
anchors.description: Finds the footprint classes that recur in the view (engine, Class discovery stringency) and lists them in the class table.

anchors.label: Class discovery stringency
anchors.description: Finer finds more, smaller classes; Coarser finds fewer. Used by the next Find footprint classes.

anchors.label: Class table
anchors.description: The classes found: one row per class with its size and prevalence bars per strand; click a name to highlight it on the reads, Save to keep it.

anchors.label: Save (a class)
anchors.where: Footprints panel > Classes tab, class table
anchors.description: Keeps a class in Saved as S1, S2, … with the run it came from, to count, filter, plot, export and compare it.

anchors.label: Plot (saved classes)
anchors.where: Footprints panel > Saved tab, above the saved classes
anchors.description: Draws the saved classes' prevalence on each strand side by side.

anchors.label: Compare strands and datasets
anchors.description: Each class's prevalence on the CT and GA strands (and other datasets) side by side: sort by discrepancy, Plot, Export TSV.

anchors.label: Dataset assay types
anchors.description: Which assay made each dataset (DddA/DddB DAF-seq or Hia5 Fiber-seq); needed to find classes.

anchors.label: Footprint size block
anchors.description: The size range saved for the selected footprint, with the size histogram around it.

anchors.label: Load (Saved footprints)
anchors.description: Loads saved footprint definitions from a file.

anchors.label: Export (Saved footprints)
anchors.description: Exports the saved definitions or their sequences as FASTA.

anchors.label: Cluster reads by N footprints
anchors.description: Clusters reads by which of the ticked saved footprints they carry (both, one, neither…); tick them under Cluster by.

anchors.label: Layer matrix
anchors.description: Opens Co-accessibility using this footprint layer.

anchors.label: Membership clusters
anchors.description: What each cluster made from saved footprints contains.
anchors.shows_when: reads were clustered by saved footprints

anchors.label: Add a track box
anchors.description: Type a TF or motif name to search JASPAR, a DNA sequence for a sequence motif, or a path/URL for a track.

anchors.label: Browse files…
anchors.description: Pick a BigWig, BigBed, BED or motif file (JASPAR, MEME, HOMER, PFM).

anchors.label: Motif options
anchors.description: Match threshold: the minimum relative PWM score for a motif hit.

anchors.label: Track row
anchors.description: One loaded track: show/hide, colour, scale, and its motif shading options.

anchors.label: Track actions
anchors.description: Show or hide every track, and save or load the track cart as JSON.

anchors.label: New DAF-seq run
anchors.description: Align and call raw DAF-seq reads (FASTQ, a folder or a Plasmidsaurus zip) against a genome or plasmid map, then open the results and their QC.

anchors.label: Search commands and settings
anchors.description: Cmd/Ctrl+K: find any command, panel or setting, or go to a locus, gene, saved region or read name. On/off settings switch in the list.

anchors.label: Search settings
anchors.description: Filters the settings sidebar as you type; with no match it offers the command palette.

anchors.label: Data (Export data)
anchors.description: Export data (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E): read names, read and class tables, BED files, projection coordinates and the session file; on a local server also a BAM subset of chosen reads.

anchors.label: Match UI size
anchors.description: Figures draw text, labels and rows as large as on screen (on by default); off draws them at 100%.

anchors.label: Highlight toolbar group
anchors.description: Shade regions in every panel on a genome: turn Highlight on and drag on a ruler (or Shift-drag a ruler any time), or highlight the view or the selected peaks.
anchors.shows_when: the Highlight group is in the toolbar row (a narrow window puts it in More)

anchors.label: Highlight controls toggle
anchors.description: Open or fold the Highlight group (colours, View, Peaks, List).
anchors.shows_when: the Highlight group is in the toolbar row (a narrow window puts it in More)

anchors.label: Highlight > View
anchors.description: Highlight what the view shows.

anchors.label: Highlight > List
anchors.description: The highlights: rename, go there, recolour or remove each; Clear all removes them.

anchors.label: Regions > Regions tab
anchors.description: Saved regions in categories (views you save, BED files, a dataset's amplicons or top regions); click one to go there, N/P step through a category.

anchors.label: Scan regions
anchors.description: Scan every open BAM for its regions (amplicons, read clusters, a targeted run's loci from its index); each dataset says what it found or why it was skipped, each region is named after its nearest gene.

anchors.label: Import BED
anchors.description: Add the regions of a BED file as a category.

anchors.label: Export BED
anchors.description: Save the ticked regions (else all listed) as a BED file.

anchors.label: Next region (N)
anchors.description: Go to the next region of the current category (N; P goes back).

anchors.label: Regions > Map tab
anchors.description: The whole chromosome or a circular plasmid map, with a zoom window of the genes around the view; Load plasmid map… is here.

anchors.label: Linked / Per panel
anchors.where: top bar, left of the chromosome selector
anchors.description: Linked: the panels on each genome move together. Per panel: each panel has its own locus box.

anchors.label: Match
anchors.description: Move the other panels on this genome to this panel's locus, without linking them.
anchors.shows_when: navigation is Per panel and another panel shows the same genome

anchors.label: Export table (Projection)
anchors.description: Download one row per read: name, dataset, strand, cluster and its x/y on the map.

anchors.label: Check robustness to read order
anchors.description: Repeat the class search with the reads in two other orders and mark each class robust or varies (about 3x slower).

anchors.label: Hide footprints cut off at read ends
anchors.description: Drop a first or last footprint under 90 bp that a read end cuts off, in the reads and the analyses (not in Find footprint classes); on by default.

anchors.label: Open Library
anchors.description: The BAMs, BigBeds and plasmid maps you open, DAF-seq runs and watched folders: search, tag and reopen them with their genome.

anchors.label: Resize the side panels
anchors.where: left edge of the side-panel drawer
anchors.description: Drag (or arrow keys) to resize the drawer of side panels; double-click for the default width.
anchors.shows_when: side panels are pinned into the drawer and the drawer is open
